parent_objective: design expanded source pool for M399-rooted target regeneration after M917 strict low-tail diversity failure
blocked_by: M917 accepted only 67 targets and strict low-tail source has only 21 seeds

public_gates: M918 must route away from strict low-tail-only target generation
M918 must preserve the P0 human-view actor contract
M918 must keep residual training, M880 exact compatibility, replay, PPO, and promotion blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not lower M917 diversity gates to pass
do not run M880 exact compatibility
do not treat mined targets as deployed rules

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_target_source: expand source coverage after strict low-tail diversity failure
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a near-tail source expansion route after M917 showed the strict low-tail source pool cannot satisfy seed coverage
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: source-expansion design only; no target generation execution, training, exact compatibility, replay, PPO, driver improvement claim, or promotion
stop_condition: stop if the design lowers M917 diversity gates instead of expanding sources
stop if the design admits residual training before regenerated targets pass source gates
stop if training, replay, PPO, or promotion is attempted
fallback_plan: if expanded source regeneration passes, route to regenerated-target residual objective design
if expanded source regeneration remains sparse, route to a larger M399 source-refresh wave
if expanded source regeneration remains concentrated, route to stronger source-balanced selection or new seed sampling
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M917 strict low-tail source coverage failure

hypothesis: The M917 failure should be handled by source expansion from M909 near-base rows, not by weakening diversity gates or training on a concentrated 67-row target file.
success_criteria: M918 identifies strict low-tail seed coverage as impossible for M917 gates
M918 pre-registers expanded near-tail source selection and pass gates for M919
M918 keeps residual training M880 exact compatibility replay PPO and promotion blocked
failure_criteria: M918 lowers M917 diversity gates without source expansion
M918 treats M917's 67 targets as sufficient for training
M918 starts training replay PPO exact compatibility or promotion
decision_rule: M918 may only design source expansion. It must not admit residual training until M919 target generation passes source diversity gates.
